diagram_previews.alt: A board of 5 rows and 4 columns coloured like a chessboard, with a blue path that starts in the top left corner, snakes along the rows (left to right, then right to left, and so on) and ends with an arrow in the bottom right corner.

difficulty_rationale: The chessboard-colouring parity argument is a standard but unstated idea, and part (b) adds a matching construction.
